findings.title: Completed extracted files display progress above 100% and lose completion indicators
findings.body: For local_size=20 and remote_size=10, this change returns 200 instead of 100. These exact supported inputs appear in view-file.service.spec.ts:246–248 with an expected result of 100. transfer-row.component.html renders the uncapped percentage at line 28 and requires exactly 100 for success styling (line 33) and the 'Done' indicator (lines 53–54). Its width clamp at line 35 protects only bar geometry, so extracted files now show 200% and lose those completion indicators.
findings.recommendation: Restore Math.min(100, ...) and retain the existing above-remote-size regression cases.

next_steps: Restore the cap and run the ViewFileService unit tests.
